newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Absa rises on expected firm interim results.
newsitem.headline: Absa rises on expected firm interim results.

text.p: Expectations of strong interim results pushed Amalgamated Banks of South Africa Ltd (Absa) more than three percent higher in active trade on Monday.
Overall trade on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange was strong with the financial index adding 30.1 points to 7,534.1.

Absa soared to 23.80 rand from 22.55 rand in early trade before dipping to 23.30 rand -- 80 cents or 3.56 percent higher. Volumes traded in the share were large with over 217,000 shares having changed hands by 0950 GMT and dealers not expecting interest in South Africa's largest bank to wane on the day.
"The market expects excellent results from Absa. They didn't disappoint when they announced year results in March. It's unlikely they'll disappoint now," one dealer said.
Absa is due to post interim results for the six months ended September 30 next Monday.
